verdict.rationale: Capacities has its own query feature: 'Smart queries' are listed as a plan feature, a 'query' can be opened as a graph alongside object type dashboards and collections, and objects carry typed custom properties to query against. Nothing in the evidence describes filtering by property values or rendering query results as live table, board or list views. missing for 10: documentation of property-based query filters, table/board/list view rendering of query results, evidence that views update live, independent or hands-on corroboration.
